data.property_text: ensures (v >= 0.0) ==> (\result >= 0.0 && \result <= v && v - \result < 1.0); ensures (v < 0.0) ==> (\result <= 0.0 && \result >= v && \result - v < 1.0);
data.rationale: jcv_ceil needs to prove \result >= v. In the v > i branch, this requires knowing that i (the truncated value) satisfies v - i < 1.0, so that i + 1 >= v. The published spec only guarantees \result <= v (for v >= 0) and \result >= v (for v < 0), but not the distance-less-than-one property needed to establish the ceil postcondition.
